title: AI-Assisted Authoring With Codex
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting AI-assisted authoring to a prompt specification that fixes every instructional decision, a pedagogy audit of the generated code, and a log of accepted and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Specify the instructional interaction precisely enough that the tool implements your design, not its defaults
Keep design decisions (sequence, feedback, separation of content) with the human author
Audit generated code for encoded pedagogy errors, not just for whether it runs
Document each accepted and rejected suggestion with the instructional reason

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
